Signature Pizzas

The pies that made the Table famous.

Every pizza starts with dough made fresh in-house and our zesty red sauce — then gets loaded edge to edge. These three are where most people start.

King Arthur's Supreme

The flagship: pepperoni, Italian sausage, mushrooms, green peppers, onions, and black olives on every slice.

The One To Beat

Sides & Appetizers

Round out the feast.

The Shareable

Chicken Wings, Two Ways

Our delicious chicken wings are oven baked (not deep fried in oil) and are available in Classic bone-in or boneless, tossed in your choice of sauce and served with our famous creamy ranch dip. Ask us to cook them well done to add a little crisp (you won't regret it!) — built for the whole table.

Why Lake Forest Comes Back

A few things we don't compromise on.

I.

Dough made fresh, daily

No shortcuts, no par-baked crusts shipped in — it's made in-house every morning.

II.

Real ingredients only

Whole-milk mozzarella, fresh-cut vegetables, and zesty sauce — every pie, every time.

III.

Run by your neighbors

Locally operated on Lambert Street — the same team behind the counter, year after year.
